commit_scope: The API Dockerfile contract test follows the image's source home (#4083 moved the runtime source to /app/runtime) and holds the image to the source-identity copy the kernel's copy flow now publishes.
evidence_refs: Observed 2026-10-20: tests/test_api_dockerfile_contract.py failed on main — it asserted `COPY form/runtime /app/form/runtime` while #4083 (2026-10-19) deliberately copies the runtime to /app/runtime, the image's source home, where source-compiler resolves runtime/fkwu-optable.h beside /app/form/.

The test now asserts the line the Dockerfile carries and the reason beside it, and additionally holds the image to `COPY --from=kernel-builder /build/form-cli.source.id` — the copy every production build of 2026-10-19 died on until the kernel's copy flow published the identity beside the copy (coherence-kernel #613, band claim 65536 in #614).

Correction: that commit's chain read `pytest … | tail -1`, which hid pytest's exit code; the file then held 10 passed and 2 failed (the staged-runner test and the sidecar test), both healed in the following commit, where the whole file passes (12 passed, pytest's own exit code checked).
